page: Google Cloud Platform m3-megamem-64 is an x86_64 memory-optimized server instance powered by an Intel Xeon processor. It features 64 dedicated virtual CPUs mapped from 32 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a base clock speed of 2.6 GHz. The processor includes a 54 MB L3 cache, 1 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache. System memory totals 976.0 GB, yielding a high resource density of 15.25 GB of RAM per vCPU. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, and comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core and memory-intensive execution capabilities. The instance achieves a PassMark CPU score of 54,571.25 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 16,654.0, both placing in the top 25% tier. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaches 293.92 GB/sec, and database operations score 26,047.32, also in the top 25%. Conversely, single-core performance is moderate, with a Geekbench single-core score of 1,577.0 and stress-ng single-core performance of 1,852.19, placing in the middle 50% tier. Memory bandwidth tests show 3,255.75 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 150.66 GB/sec for uncached large blocks.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the m3-megamem-64 is designed for workloads requiring massive memory footprints relative to compute resources, trading off local storage and GPU acceleration for high RAM density. The hardware configuration is optimized for large-scale in-memory databases, memory-intensive data processing, enterprise applications, and complex multi-threaded operations such as software compilation and image processing.
